rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Client-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: If a conditional expression always evaluates to true or always evaluates to false, this suggests incomplete code or a logic error.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: Conditional comments are an IE-specific feature and not portable.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')
rules.description: Building a database query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Prepending a backslash to an ordinary character in a string does not have any effect, and may make regular expressions constructed from this string behave unexpectedly.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: Server-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
rules.description: Separately checking the state of a file before operating on it may allow an attacker to modify the file between the two operations.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Conditions that the user controls are not suited for making security-related decisions.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: If a dollar assertion '$' appears in a regular expression before another term that cannot match the empty string, then this assertion can never match, so the entire regular expression cannot match any string.

rules.cwe_name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
rules.description: Using cookies without CSRF protection may allow malicious websites to submit requests on behalf of the user.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Comparing different kinds of HTTP request data may be a symptom of an insufficient security check.
